title: Hillside Farms
about: Hillside Farms sits in the hills of Cortland County, just east of the hamlet of Truxton. Alexa Newton’s family bought the land in 1941, and in 2017 Alexa and her husband, Jacob, took it over, making them the fourth generation to farm there. Together they raise beef, pork, chickens and turkeys, and they feed more than 250 local families.

The Newtons farm regeneratively. Cattle graze the pasture and the woods, and Jacob has led Cornell Cooperative Extension tours of his silvopasture. The chickens and turkeys live in shelters that move across the grass, so the birds always have fresh ground to graze and forage. In 2024 the Newtons opened a state-licensed poultry processing room on the farm. It lets them cut birds into portions for restaurants and grocers and handle poultry for neighboring farms that had nowhere close to go. Unsold parts go back into the farm’s compost.
Eden has bought beef and chicken from the Newtons for several years. You can also find them at the CNY Regional Market in Syracuse.
